_about: Public-domain Juan Eusebio Nieremberg (1595-1658), Spanish Jesuit, for the Word Hoard: A Treatise of the Difference betwixt the Temporal and Eternal in Sir Vivian Mullineaux's translation (1672; Dublin eleventh edition 1857; and Matthew Russell's revision), A Meditation of Life and Death (Oxford, 1682) and Of Adoration in Spirit and Truth in the old English translation (1885), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 37 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

nieremberg-temporal-eternal-1672: A Treatise of the Difference betwixt the Temporal and Eternal, tr. Sir Vivian Mullineaux (printed in the year 1672)
nieremberg-meditation-life-death-1682: A Meditation of Life and Death, translated with some alterations out of the works of Eusebius Nierembergius (Oxford: L. L. for Tho. Fickus, 1682)
nieremberg-temporal-eternal-1857: A Treatise on the Difference between Temporal and Eternal, the eleventh edition (Dublin: James Duffy, 1857)
nieremberg-temporal-eternal-russell: The Difference between Temporal and Eternal, tr. Sir Vivian Molyneux, revised by Matthew Russell, S.J. (Dublin: James Duffy and Co.; title page undated, catalogued 1884)
nieremberg-adoration-1885: Of Adoration in Spirit and Truth, the old English translation, new edition, Quarterly Series vol. 50 (London: Burns and Oates, 1885)

_alternates.nieremberg-copies: Of Adoration in Spirit and Truth (1673, title page illegible); Cummiskey's Philadelphia edition (catalogued 1833, title page not read)

_excluded.nieremberg-other: Prudential Reflections (1674: the title page does not name him); Contemplations of the State of Man (the title page credits Jeremy Taylor); Scheeben's Glories of Divine Grace; Lady Lovat's Marvels of Divine Grace (based on him)
